description: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during Whisper fine-tuning (type = tiny) across different model configurations over a series of epochs. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 30 to 70 at intervals of 10. The plot contains five gray lines representing different configurations. The line labeled "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" is a solid line with circle markers; it shows a steady decline from approximately 68.8 at epoch 0 to 36.2 at epoch 6. The line labeled "tiny" (with partially obscured text in the legend) is a solid line with square markers; it begins at 59.8 at epoch 0, experiences a slight plateau between epoch 1 (51.2) and epoch 2 (50.8), and then declines to end at 32.2 at epoch 6. The line labeled "tiny int4" is a dashed line with circle markers; it starts at 68.8 at epoch 0, declines to 39.4 at epoch 4, and then remains relatively steady, ending at 40.1 at epoch 6. The line labeled "tiny int8" is a dashed line with square markers; it starts at 59.8 at epoch 0, drops to 46.8 at epoch 1, declines more gradually to 37.4 at epoch 5, and ends at 37.0 at epoch 6. Finally, the line labeled "tiny full" is a dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it maintains a much lower and relatively steady decline throughout the observed period, starting at 28.8 at epoch 0 and ending at 23.0 at epoch 6.
